summary: On paper Denver has the edge (Denver's defense ranks 12th in EPA per dropback, +0.01 allowed). Under center, Bo Nix ranks 13th of 31 in EPA per dropback and Justin Herbert ranks 31st; x-factor: Jaylen Waddle averages 3.5 yards of separation, 11th of 76, and the Chargers' pass defense ranks 8th. The model favors Denver at 88%, mostly on rushing matchup (4.2 pts) and passing matchup (4.1 pts).
